title: knowledge(data-modeling): keep business state independent of Job Queue lifetime
summary: A new knowledge article explains how to preserve business state independently of Job Queue lifetime by storing it on business-owned records rather than relying on Job Queue Entry existence as a status indicator. The article includes good and bad code examples and adds discovery logic to the data-modeling review skill.
key_points: Deleting a Job Queue Entry can lose business state when the entry is the only evidence of an unresolved condition
State that must survive cleanup belongs on the business owner or a domain record with the right lifetime
Job Queue Entry should run the work and reference the owner record
Data-modeling review gains discovery cues for existence reads and cleanup paths
A finding needs an identified business consumer and a deletion path that changes its result; a FlowField or table extension name alone is not enough
quote: Store state that must survive execution cleanup on its business owner or a domain record with the required lifetime.
